CustomField.label: Event Type
CustomField.description: ★R6 Reads up to the parent event's Event_Type__c. Note what has no counterpart here: Topic__c is a multi-select picklist and a formula cannot render one as text, only test it with INCLUDES(). So the attendee-side related list and report show the event's shape but not its subject; filtering by subject has to go through the Marketing Event report type, whose base object is the event itself. That asymmetry is a cost of the multi-select, recorded rather than worked around.
